The '''Royal Nothoiin Constabulary''' was the local [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police force]] on [[Nothoiin/Legends|Nothoiin]]. After the disappearance of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zatch (bounty hunter)|Zatch]] during the [[Ambush of the Goldskin Parade|ambush]] of the [[Goldskin Parade]], the Royal Nothoiin Constabulary believed that Zatch could still be at large, likely armed and dangerous.
